summary: Verified the new 'Walk me through it' feature end-to-end (backend + frontend). Ran targeted pytest suites (test_day_walkthrough.py = 3/3, test_live_voice.py = 8/8), plus the live-voice session guard and /api/home regression, plus the full Playwright walkthrough with fake WebRTC + route mocks and the regression case for talk-to-jessi without open/greet_instruction. All checks passed.
critical_code_review_comments: WalkMyDayButton correctly gates on config.available && config.configured; hidden in preview because OPENAI_API_KEY is unset.
Walkthrough session's greet_instruction + open payload flow through useLiveJessi.openAtStart -> LiveJessiProvider.pathFor -> pill collapse as designed.
next_stop delegation is handled client-side with ack/res/ui event ids and a route change, matching TOOL_LABELS.next_stop wiring.

seed_data_creation: None. test_day_walkthrough.py seeds + wipes 'QA Walk' data for activation-tester internally.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend: pytest test_day_walkthrough.py 3 passed (~7s incl. real-LLM test); pytest test_live_voice.py 8 passed (~26s). API regression: POST /api/live-voice/session {mode:'assistant', sdp:'v=0 x', overrides:{walkthrough:true}} -> 503 with OPENAI_API_KEY reason (expected). GET /api/home/{forest_uid} -> 200 with keys ['streak','my_3','wins_feed','dismissed_keys']. Frontend gating: without mocks walk-my-day-btn NOT rendered; talk-to-jessi-btn shows 'Needs OPENAI_API_KEY on the server. Tap to open the Voice Lab.'. Walkthrough Playwright (fake WebRTC + route mocks, forest): walk-my-day-btn visible in Do-this-next card with 'Walk me through it'; tap -> live-jessi-sheet 'Your day with Jessi'; __dcSent contains a session.instructions.append event_id 'greet_1' whose content starts with 'Open with this' and contains 'First up: Reply to Jeremy Cole'; app navigates to /thread/<real contact id> within ~2s of session.started; pill (live-jessi-pill) collapses with live-jessi-pill-where '· Jeremy'. After window.__emit({type:'session.delegation.created', delegation:{id:'d1', target:'client'}}): __dcSent gains 'ack_d1','res_d1','ui_d1'; URL -> /contact/<id>; pill-where '· Jesse'. Tapping the pill expands and live-jessi-hint reads 'Jessi runs your board top to bottom. Say "draft it", "done", "skip" or "next" and she moves on.'. live-jessi-end triggers session.close on the data channel. Regression: without open/greet_instruction, talk-to-jessi-btn opens 'Talk to Jessi' sheet; greet_1 content starts with 'Greet the rep immediately'; no navigation off /home. Fake WebRTC gotcha: the browser's `useLiveJessi` awaits iceGatheringState === 'complete', so the FakePC must expose iceGatheringState='complete' from the start (or dispatch icegatheringstatechange), otherwise you get 'Timed out while gathering ICE candidates'.
